    'appium:skipUnlock': True,

})

from appium.webdriver.common.action_chains import ActionChains
from appium.webdriver.common.actions import interaction
from appium.webdriver.common.actions.action_builder import ActionBuilder
from appium.webdriver.common.actions.pointer_input import PointerInput
finger = PointerInput(interaction.POINTER_TOUCH, 'finger')
actions = ActionChains(driver)
actions.w3c_actions = ActionBuilder(driver, mouse=finger)
actions.w3c_actions.pointer_action.move_to_location(540, 1800)
actions.w3c_actions.pointer_action.pointer_down()
actions.w3c_actions.pointer_action.pause(0.15)
actions.w3c_actions.pointer_action.move_to_location(540, 500)
actions.w3c_actions.pointer_action.release()
actions.perform()
WebDriverWait(driver, 5).until(lambda d: 'apps_view' in d.page_source or 'All apps' in d.page_source or d.current_package=='com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher')
{'package':driver.current_package,'activity':driver.current_activity}
